project_name: Sarcasm & Irony Detection System using NLP
preprocessing: Classical cleaning (lowercase, URL/mention normalization, punctuation preservation)
dataset: Kaggle 4-class Sarcasm and Irony Dataset (Decontaminated v1.0)
selected_reason: Selected in Phase 9 based on achieving the highest Macro F1-score (0.7187) across all evaluated models (outperforming BERT at 0.6935 and GloVe Bi-LSTM at 0.6940). LinearSVM is the only architecture that maintains active discrimination on the minority Figurative class without collapsing to zero recall. Furthermore, it delivers ultra-low inference latency (0.027 ms/text, >1,400x faster than BERT) and a minimal memory footprint (<500MB), making it optimal for high-throughput production deployment.
